nom: florence by mills Clear The Way Clarifying Face Wash

i've used many face washes over the years and this has to be in my top 3. it leaves my skin feeling more hydrated than before i used it, and i wash my face and i am GLOWING ! i absolutely adore this product.

This is handw down the best morning cleanser I've ever used. Its gentle, has a pleasant scent, gives you the richest foam put of any foam cleanser I've ever used, clears up and prevents acne…it's just perfect, and I really hope the formula never changes or this gets discotinued. It's on sale now and I bought 4 bottles and honestly might get more because its not usually on sale…so now I'm REALLY hoping it isn't being phased out.

avis.titre: Not a fan of the scent
avis.texte: I read reviews before purchasing and noticed a few mentions of the scent, but still gave it a try. The first few uses, the scent didn't bother me too much, but then I just couldn't continue using it. It began drying my skin out and leaving super dry red patches, especially over my cheeks. Just wasn't for me.

I absolutely LOVE this face wash! The foam is thick and creamy and cleanses my skin without overdrying. Some reviews mention the smell and yes, there is a strong lavender scent but it's real lavender essential oil, not that nasty perfume lavender. I love the smell and the infredients are clean and effective.
I absolutely love Millie but this made me break out bad.My face is red after and it mafe my face burn bad.This could just be me no hate love you Millie💜

your face feels and looks clean after use but left my skin with lines and a stinging sensation. probably once a week use not for everyday. does not smell good at all, it smells like chemicals. I have eczema prone skin. dry with sensitivity.

First off - if you are looking for a makeup removing face wash, this is not it. It does not advertise itself as such, granted. From it's description, this is a face wash meant to "control oil, while salicylic acid helps minimize the appearance of pores. Glycolic and lactic acids help exfoliate surface layers of skin for smoother, softer texture." I recommend this is as a morning face wash. It reminds me a bit of the Shiseido Complete Cleansing Microfoam - intentional dupe or not, I don't know, but I know I really like this face wash.
i hate lavender, and i'm saying that. it is so gentle and nice on the skin, it smells so great… it irritates my jaw area sometimes but i'm very sensitive there…

I got this product as a part of my gratice and tried it on a whim. I have been struggling aith raised bumps on my face that arent pimples but i cant pop or pick at them. I used this face wash ONE TIME and my skin legitimately looks facetuned in real life. I honestly havent tried anything else from this brand so im not sure how everything else preforms, but THIS product DID THAT 👏🏻👏🏻 highly recommended!

A gentle yet very cleansing wash. Leaves my skin smooth. Does not irritate my skin. Does not cause acne. Does not cause excess oil production. However, if I use it too often or leave it on my face too long it can make my skin feel dry and stiff. However, still worth it.
It's a great product, not a fan of the smell of the clear the way set but this is great! i like how the cleanser is foam and why i love my skincare routine!

I usually only do reviews when i'm absolutely blown away by a product and actually finished it to see results. When I say that this cleanser is all that!!! Wow. Took years off my face I swear. It battled my hyperpigmentation, it's hydrating (*skin looking like a drink of water from a glass bottle), even reduced inflammation. Got my rough texture all the way together and my skin always felt clean but not tight and dried. Dewy and ready for the rest of my regimen. Note: I use the Salicylic Acid moisturizer by CeraVe with this cleanser. Great pairing.
